# LinkedIn Posts Dataset
## Power AI Agents Instantly
### Documentation
cURL

Python

Javascript

## LinkedIn Posts Dataset FAQs
When you order the LinkedIn Posts dataset - or filter it via API - Bright Data generates a **snapshot**: a point-in-time export of your selected records. The async workflow runs as follows: (1) your order or API call **triggers** the collection job; (2) you can **poll** the job status using the snapshot ID; (3) once complete, you **download** the snapshot via the API or your configured delivery destination. Snapshot metadata (including error codes and initiation type) is accessible via the [Snapshot Metadata API](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/marketplace-dataset-api/get-snapshot-meta).

How to scrape LinkedIn data in bulk
web.description:
## Documentation Index
This guide shows you how to scrape LinkedIn data at scale using the asynchronous `/trigger` endpoint.

## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/async-requests#step-1-trigger-the-collection)  Step 1: Trigger the collection
Python

```
curl -X POST \
  "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/trigger?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[\
    {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella"},\
    {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffweiner08"},\
    {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/rbranson"},\
    {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/sherylsandberg"},\
    {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/raboram"}\
  ]'
```

```
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/trigger",
    params={
        "dataset_id": "gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0",
        "format": "json",
    },
    headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    json=[\
        {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella"},\
        {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffweiner08"},\
        {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/rbranson"},\
        {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/sherylsandberg"},\
        {"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/raboram"},\
    ],
)

snapshot = response.json()
print("Snapshot ID:", snapshot["snapshot_id"])
```

```
const response = await fetch(
  "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/trigger?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json",
  {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify([\
      { url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella" },\
      { url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffweiner08" },\
      { url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/rbranson" },\
      { url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/sherylsandberg" },\
      { url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/raboram" },\
    ]),
  }
);

const snapshot = await response.json();
console.log("Snapshot ID:", snapshot.snapshot_id);
```

You should see a `200` response with a `snapshot_id`:

```
{
  "snapshot_id": "s_m1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h"
}
```

You need it to check progress and download results.

## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/async-requests#step-3-download-results)  Step 3: Download results
```
curl "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/s_m1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h?format=json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -o results.json
```

## [​](https://docs.brightdata.com/datasets/scrapers/linkedin/async-requests#skip-polling-with-webhooks)  Skip polling with webhooks
```
curl -X POST \
  "https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/trigger?dataset_id=gd_l1viktl72bvl7bjuj0&format=json&endpoint=https://your-server.com/webhook" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[{"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella"}]'
```

## Step 3: Build the agent (two ways)
### Node 3: Trigger LinkedIn data collection (HTTP request)
**What it does:** Initiates the scraping job with Bright Data's API.

### Node 7: Fetch LinkedIn profile data (HTTP request)
- **Prompt:** Construct the URL: **[https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/](https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/)** followed by the **snapshot_id** from the "Trigger LinkedIn Data Collection" node's output, then add **?format=json** at the end.
- **Example result:** **[https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/s\_abc123xyz789?format=json](https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/s\_abc123xyz789?format=json)**
